about_the_game:
Torn Veil is a first-person psychological horror game that plunges you into a chilling narrative of scientific ambition, moral decay, and the terrifying consequences of playing god. Torn Veil combines stunning visuals, immersive sound design, and a deeply unsettling atmosphere to deliver an unforgettable horror experience.In this demo, you’ll experience the first level of the game "the ground floor", where the story begins. This is the heart of the mystery, where the Torn Veil Project was born. You'll uncover early clues, learn the game’s core mechanics, and begin piecing together the unsettling truth that lies beneath the surface.The full version of the game will continue your descent into the unknown, expanding the story and deepening the horror. You'll explore:

  • The Ground Floor (from the demo)

  • The Study Room, filled with documents and events

  • Secret Rooms hidden behind memories

  • The Archive Maze, where the past twists and turns

  • And a final, haunting section where your journey leads to the Final Encounter

Uncover what happened to the missing characters, face the consequences of soul-bound experiments, and witness the truth behind the Torn Veil.
Step into the world of Torn Veil and experience a horror game that will leave you questioning the very nature of existence. Are you ready to face the darkness?

Wishlist now and prepare to uncover the secrets of the Torn Veil.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD RX 560 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti or AMD RX 580 (6 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
